reviews.title: Unable to obtain refund due to THEIR error
reviews.text: This airline is a scam. I was trying to book a ticket but kelt getting an error on the website. As I was travelling for business I had to make arrangements via an alternative carrier. However several minutes later I got a confirmation via email. I contacted them within 10 minutes of receiving their email to ask them to cancel because of their error and was told that the ticket is non-refundable. It is completely unreasonable that I must be punished because their website does not function properly. I expect better in terms of technology and customer service in 2023.
reviews.author: WandaRah

reviews.title: Very bad services
reviews.text: So Jambo Jet has a 4hr delay from MYD-NBO but they don't prefer to inform their clients. They only inform their clients 8minutes to departure. What happened to good customer service? What happened to communication? I ask myself.... Is it that they didn't know about the delay or they don't care about their customers. I hate this airline.!

reviews.title: Cancellation of flight
reviews.text: Our flight was cancelled today at 11:55 am and until now after nearly 6 hours still waiting for a 45 minutes flight. With no communication and no advice, colleagues changing shifts and leaving us here. Lydia a supervisor at the mombasa desk left us here with all our frustrations and left new team to take over without proper hand over. I had to go visit my son today on his school visiting day and my requests fell on deaf ears. This is very frustrating for a parent who hasnt seen their child for a while only to miss the visiting due to flight cancellation that made us as passengers feel blamed for something we didnt cause. We booked specific time because we had plans and now to be in the airport until 6pm for another flight is something i would clasify as pathetic. This is very sad especially knowing that other passengers were given other altertantives and we were left here, pleding for our fate. Now i havent seen my son in school who is a candidate and being in a boarding school is even tough. I have no way of explaining to him the reason why we couldnt see him today. Have a way of communicating with your passengers and ensuring everyone is catered for. Waiting for a response.

reviews.title: Pathetic service
reviews.text: The hostesses were very unprofessional and wouldn't listen to me despite them talking to my family Doctor.They made me wait for 2 hours for the next flight.i would definitely never recommend.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: I was alighted from the plane unapologetically and notified that I couldn't travel as I was pregnant .The hostess spoke to my Gynaecologist and said that I was fit for travel as it was just a 45min trip.They insisted I had to go to the port health and the person in the clinic didn't even touch me just filled in forms so I didn't see any essence of me missing the flight. I am so disappointed with the service definitely not traveling with you again.

reviews.title: Very pathetic airhostess!
reviews.text: Pathetic airhostess acting smart trying to force my 3 year old child to wear seat belt even though he was completely refusing which resulted to him crying and screaming for over 15 minutes. Due to this stubbornness of hers, all the other passengers got disturbed which resulted to one passenger swearing at my son to 'shut the f** up'. We as parents tried to make our son understand to wear the seat belt but he was just refusing. We have travelled internationally and domestically with our child and we have never encountered such stubbornness from any cabin crew. @Jambojet please train your crew to be abit understanding in certain situations that even the parents can't control. We will be re thinking our travels with jambojet in the future.

reviews.title: Flight delay
reviews.text: Had a bad experience traveling with Jambojet. The flight from Ukunda was delayed, we weren’t given reasons for the delay, some staff were talking about technical issues and some talking about the airstrip, no refreshments were served whilst we were waiting in a hot airport, what’s even worse the air hostesses in the plane seemed frustrated. What happened to service with a smile!!
reviews.author: Samira J

reviews.title: Clean, comfortable easy way to travel. Well worth the extra expense
reviews.text: Slight delay on both outbound and return, however the flight was quick, the plane clean and the staff friendly! We met family who had taken the coach and we were infinitely grateful we flew.
reviews.author: Laura t

reviews.title: Always delaying and unapologetic
reviews.text: I have flied with jambojet 4 times and all of the flights delayed. The worst delayed 1 hour and 40 mins and when I asked the staff at the sales office , he said "it's normal, some flights even delay for 6 hours" with a very unapologetic tone. I am really disappointed and will never use them.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Timely, no delays. Courteous and very welcoming staff. Good legroom. Greatest value for money. Excellent!
reviews.author: Paulina M.

reviews.title: Cancelled flights with no real reason
reviews.text: Jambo We had planned our Kenyan trip from August 2022 and have booked a flight departing from Nairobi to Ukunda at the same period. Our trip was planned for December 2022 for the Christmas time. Our booking was anticipated more than 4 months in advance. Right after our safari we were due to departs from Nairobi to Ukunda so we could enjoy a relaxing moment along the Indian cost of Diani beach. 4 days prior to our departure we received an email from JamboJet, the very first since we booked 4 months ago saying that our 3PM flight was cancelled and offering another one at 8AM on the same day. Not only such an email came very late in our travel as we were in the middle of our safari tour but the 8am schedule couldn’t fit at all as we had a 5 hour driving ahead before reaching the airport. After back and forth emails with the customer center they end up telling us that the reason they cancelled the flight was « The Kenya Airports Authority is undertaking runway and ramp extension works at Ukunda Airstrip. Due to the large aircraft type that Jambojet uses for its operations (Dash 8 Q-400), we cannot safely land and take off with all booked passengers » After 2 days of stressful times trying to find another flight at the busiest time of the year we end up finding a Mombasa flight with an additional 2 hour transportation time. When arriving at the Nairobi airport to take our Mombasa flight we had the delight to see that our flight JM8692 was scheduled with a final destination to Ukunda. As a conclusion I would NOT recommend JamboJet at all to all travelers, if you want to avoid having a company that jeopardizes your entire travel with last minutes changes, no plan B solution that can be acceptable and no compensation. Additionally this same company is openly telling big lies as we could see with our eyes that the exact same flight was scheduled. Are they ashamed of practicing heavy overbooking policy ?! The additional charges we have incurred are of more that €300 and we have waisted more that 6 hours in our tight planning.
reviews.author: Christophe

reviews.title: Worst Experience Ever
reviews.text: I’m giving this flight service 1 star only because 0 stars is not available. Disorder with the timing of tickets or announcements of the gates led us to miss our flight. On enquiry, the attendants were extremely rude and unhelpful. First and Last time using this service 🗑️🚮

reviews.text: They charged me $56 to change a flight, i had mistakenly swapped the destination & departure. This was still a week away from the flight, it was barely booked & the other flight was actually cheaper.

reviews.title: Worst airlines scammers
reviews.text: They find ways to scam people any way they can. Surcharging and hidden costs. Bad service and cheap.
reviews.author: Frankyd

reviews.title: Poor Customer Experience and Felt Unsafe
reviews.text: We bought drinks (coffees and Dawa) after going through security while waiting at the gate. When we were about to board, the staff did not let us bring in the drinks we had just bought, so we had to throw them out. If we wanted a beverage (including water) on the plane, we would have had to buy it as none were offered as part of the package. We essentially wasted money on the drinks we bought and then would have had to pay more if we wanted to drink something, which we felt was unfair and frustrating. The air hostess was also unfriendly and rude when giving instructions and when we had questions. When we were disembarking the aeroplane, another plane about 15 meters ahead of us was about to take off. They allowed ten people to walk past the aircraft before stopping the rest of us from waiting on the ground for it to move ahead and take off. This showed that they were not organised well, and we did not feel safe. I do not plan to fly with JamboJet again. My experiences with Skywards Express has been much better.
reviews.author: RSShah

reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: I’ve really bad experience with one of your workers. She was very rude and unprofessional. She refused to give me back my passport and my boarding card because I didn’t wear mask. I explained to her that I’ve medical condition and I have problem with breathing and I’m fully vaccinated. I even show her my medical documents and she refused to look at them. She was very loud and rude. I almost miss my flight to ukunda because she was holding my passport and refused to give it to me. The worst experience ever!

reviews.title: Great airline

reviews.title: A convenient way to tarvel from Nbo to Diani, when one comes from Europe
reviews.text: Having come from Europe I had two suitcases of 23Kg each so having the option to travel from JKIA to Diani with the possibility of two suitcases is very convenient. The other airlines that cover Diani leave from Wilson, which is more convenient, but they are smaller aircraft so do not have the possibility of 2x23kg bags. The service and schedule of Jambojet is also an advantage.

reviews.title: Worst customer Experience

I remember requesting a crew Arnold to assist get me bag from the top storage and he left and never came back to assist. As I was onboarding I made him aware of his attitude and he unappologetically told me if I wanted I can go to the manager and complain!!! Work on your customer experience!

reviews.title: Poor aircraft maintenance
reviews.text: I was okay flying from Nairobi to Malindi Kenya but while on my return trip on the 15th of may 2022. It was 8.30 Am flight and as I was boarding the aircraft I was in shock because I saw very worn out tires. In fact they had peeled off a few layers I clearly see broken wires and bald tires without tread. It was a scary flight please management fix and maintain your fleet. Who inspected the plane and cleared it good for service on that day? Public safety was highly compromised. Peter
reviews.author: Peter K

reviews.title: Kind and considerate staff
reviews.text: I’d like acknowledge the kindness of staff from Jambojet on the Malindi-Nairobi 7pm flight on 9 April. My son had inadvertently booked an earlier flight, which we only discovered when we tried to check in. We had a connecting flight to the UK, and the Jambojet flight was fully booked, so it seemed he was going to miss the connection. We were already on the plane and my son had just got into a taxi to go back to Watamu, when one of the crew members told us there was a no-show. A quick call was made to my son to turn the taxi around. The plane was held and ground staff rushed my son through and on to the plane. Apologies to the rest of the passengers for the 15 minute delay, but it made a huge difference for us. Thank you Jambo Jet!

The call centre made it easy for us to pay using Mpesa and sorted out another payment on a different booking when the payment glitched. The facility to add extra bags was helpful for us. The flights were punctual, the check-in smooth. We were very happy with the service taht we received.

I understand the idea of trying to save money but I would suggest flying with KLM if possible. JamboJet are thieves. Please do not waste you time and money.

Travelers beware (especially foreigners)

reviews.author: Kalu y

reviews.title: Horrendous Booking System
reviews.text: Absolute worst booking system I have ever encountered. I tried to book a flight from Malindi to Nairobi and it kept telling me that an error has occurred. My friend had the exact same issue two weeks ago trying to book the same flight. After spending 40 minutes with an incapable call assistant on the phone, trying to book it a million other ways, nothing worked! She ended up having to pay directly at the airport right before her flight. Since I did not have the patience for an endless phone call, we went to the Jambo Jet store in the centre of Malindi. The lady was very helpful and managed to book everything easily for the same price as in the online booking. Jambo Jet should seriously work on their booking system, or at least give some sort of discount or anything for the inconveniences caused...
reviews.author: Lucie S

reviews.title: Terrible online booking platform experience
reviews.text: The platform is not user friendly and creates confusion. I booked online but once I was checking in, the information they had on their system appeared to be conflicting. Even after producing photo evidence of my booking, they claimed I had to dig in my pocket and produce information changing fees...money minting tricks. Upgrade the online platform or pull it down, and use manual system.
reviews.author: Jemo

reviews.title: Had a terrific experience flying with Jambo Jet from Ukunda to Nairobi
reviews.text: As the worlds most travelled person I enjoyed my flight on Jambo Jet. I think the welcome to the flight was great and Jambo is just the right name for this airline. I ordered a vodka and orange juice and was very pleased to see it was a decent size bottle not like to usual tiny ones that is usual on airlines. The flight was good from the check-in to boarding and was on time and arrival at Wilson was also on time . I found the aircraft was had a delightful light and airy colour scheme and was very relaxing to fly in. The crew were attentive and professional. I would recommend Jambo Jet as a great way to travel to the coast. I look forward to my next trip in March . Fred Finn Guinness World record 15 million miles and 718 flights in Concorde
reviews.author: flyfinnn

reviews.title: Jambo jet misleading airfares
reviews.text: I booked my air ticket with jambo jet. The airfare advertised online was 4100 to Mombasa and 5100 from Mombasa to Nairobi. I therefore paid 9200/=. When I arrived at the airport I was told the airfare is not inclusive of buggage. I therefore was charged an extra 2250/=. I believe that this is a sales trick...the advertised price should include baggage like other normal flights. If not the advertised price should indicate that it is not inclusive of normal baggage; or indicate that the advertised price is for airfare plus hand luggage only. Jambo jet needs to have sales integrity and transparency. Im not flying again with jambo jet.

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service at Call Centre

reviews.title: Trip to visit Impala Ecolodge Kisumu with my wife.
reviews.text: This particular flight, on 19th January 2020 at 09:30 am, was on-time and so was the return flight 3 days later. The cabin crew were nice and very approachable. I recall one of our hand carry bags could not easily fit into the overhead racks, and the cabin attendant was kind enough to take it to the floor cabin near the entrance. Everything remaining equal, Jambojet will still be my No.1 choice for domestic transportation.
reviews.author: William A

reviews.title: Very Unreliable. Almost missed my international connecting flight!!!!
reviews.text: I had a 7:15 pm international flight to catch from JKIA. After booking a 3 pm flight from Eldoret, I rested easy knowing I had more than enough time. These guys changed the flight departure time at the last minute to 5pm! That would mean I had about 1 hour to catch my international flight. With all the luggage I had, I needed a miracle to make it. Jambojet tried their best and literally had one of their agents take me to the front of a quite long queue and facilitated the luggage check in. Its for this reason that I am giving them 3 stars and not 1. All these efforts would have still had me miss the flight were it not for a 30 minute delay. I can't imagine how much I would have had to pay and the sort of inconvenience I would endure!
reviews.author: Mahlon K

reviews.title: Irresponsible and unprofessional airline
reviews.text: I should have listened to the reviews, this airline is totally unreliable. They cancel flight all the time and always delayed. My wife and I missed our next flight from Nairobi after being delayed for 5 hours in Mombasa. After 5 hours with the check-in supervisor who's acting as if he's doing me a favor, we ended up with nothing and had to make a brand new reservation which cost us $750. a lot of the reviews here are true there service is horrible.
